plain_english_policy: Enactment would authorize Alabama residents to purchase special license plates honoring deceased family members for an additional $25 annual fee per vehicle; all revenue from these fees would be deposited into the State General Fund.
policy_direction_if_enacted: The policy direction is to create a new voluntary program allowing personalized 'in memory' license plates while establishing a dedicated funding stream (the $25 fee) that flows directly to the state's general budget rather than being earmarked for specific programs or agencies.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Morrow advanced this bill as a public safety and homeland security measure, likely framing it within broader legislative priorities around community recognition and administrative revenue generation rather than partisan ideology.
evidence_quotes: This bill would provide for the issuance of a personalized in memory license plate honoring deceased family members.

owners of motor vehicles who are residents of Alabama shall upon request be issued a personalized in memory license plate honoring deceased family members... payment of an additional annual fee of twenty-five dollars ($25).
The additional revenues derived from the sales of the distinctive motor vehicle license plates shall be distributed monthly to the State General Fund.
